problem: The bounded facet work had two remaining cross-provider/UI contract defects at the reviewed head: canonical capability and unit IDs were normalized into near-match aliases, and duplicate hidden desktop/mobile sidebars reused the same availability description IDs. The frozen discovery-result v1.0.0 schema still forbids response-field additions. The combined gate then recorded four subject-shortcircuit fixture failures because intentional facet option label strings differed from the raw-label frozen control; this correction keeps that historical failure and the frozen reference engines intact. Independent Astra follow-up then identified two remaining provider defects on the working patch later committed as 073a09da002df395e30c7394e256525035f1db61: raw legacy data-category and reporting-unit sections must reach the legacy matcher, and recorded query/embedded-receipt filters must replay as exact canonical wire IDs. This metadata continuation does not rewrite those historical failures or the original producer identity.
resulting_behavior: Canonical source, geography, access_status, unit_of_analysis and capability request values now compare exact wire IDs across the shared adapter and retrieval engine. An explicit fixture/browser compatibility boundary preserves only the existing legacy section aliases plus geography:pennsylvania -> US-PA and access/catalog-metadata-only -> public_catalog; canonical API parsing and the frozen response shape remain unchanged. FixtureDiscoveryProvider applies same-dimension OR and cross-dimension AND filters, recomputes counts in its bounded fixture scope and keeps response metadata consistent. Unknown geography/access controls remain count-free when absent, selected values survive narrowed and empty responses and remain removable with scoped availability reasons. Retrieval-core continues to change only existing facet option labels, resolving complete-match captured names without inventing scientific meaning. FacetSidebar derives per-instance availability reason IDs with React useId so each input references the paragraph in its own desktop or mobile instance. The additive subject-shortcircuit correction isolates only facets.sections[*].options[*].label differences across all 16 fixture/sort comparisons, asserts the independent public label map and rejects a representative pagination.total_matches mutation. Frozen schemas, types, reference engines, manifests, fingerprints and source bytes are unchanged. After C-006-4-R1, FixtureDiscoveryProvider preserves raw legacy section tokens through matching so data-category and reporting-unit aliases still select the legacy value normalizer; canonical query values remain exact wire IDs; same-dimension values OR and cross-dimension values AND; query and embedded receipt facet_filters record effective canonical wire IDs that replay against the retrieval engine.
